mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (over the last 3 months) signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by more than 0.5% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in CPIAUCSL above 315 signals persistent inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to rising real rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 315, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) signal an overheating economy, which triggers central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (HOUST below 1200 and INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to declining corporate earnings and risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a weakening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek safe havens in equities during early recession signals.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 1300 and RSAFS above 700000), the S&P 500 tends to have positive returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment strengthen.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (over the last 3 months) signals a tightening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profit margins expand due to reduced wage pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE has fallen by more than 0.3% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) and a decline in housing starts (HOUST below 1250) signal an accelerating economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1250, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
